compute_matrix_inverse_root: compute the inverse root of a square symmetric positive definite matrix using eigendecomposition or Newton iteration
compute_matrix_eigendecomposition: compute the eigendecomposition of a symmetric matrix using torch.linalg.eigh or the QR algorithm
orthogonalize_matrix: orthogonalize a matrix using SVD decomposition or quintic Newton-Schulz iteration
compute_inverse_root_from_eigenvalues: compute the inverse root of a matrix from pre-computed eigenvalues and eigenvectors
check_newton_convergence_flag: check the NewtonConvergenceFlag enum to determine if a Newton iteration converged, reached max iters, or early stopped
